Audio insights and attribution in one platform.

Plan, track, and optimize your campaigns more efficiently with Magellan Al's integrated platform. See why the top brands, publishers, and agencies trust Magellan Al with their audio attribution and research needs.

Book a demo
Press release

Magellan AI Announces Expanded Partnership with iHeartMedia to Bring Broadcast Radio Attribution to Advertisers

Hailed as The Google of podcasting, our deep toolkit empowers publishers, agencies, and brands to succeed.

Grow podcast investments

Gain detailed insights to track competitor spend and messaging. Our advanced discovery tools also provide deep metrics on inventory and audiences, and put you directly in touch with the right people.

Competitive intelligenceMedia planning

Validate every ad placement

We capture and analyze every ad placement to automate airchecks and brand safety. Instant notifications and scheduled reports provide added confidence that every exposure is in the right position, at the right length, and with no competitors or questionable content in the episode.

Ad verificationBrand safety

Keep tabs on conversions

Whether promoting a brand or a show, pixel-based tracking captures events and activity across podcast, broadcast, streaming audio, and video channels. With multiple methodologies and variable lookback windows, our fully customized reporting evolves with your needs.

Pixel-based attributionPod-to-pod attribution

Localized markets

Analyze podcasts and brands active in region-specific markets. Our tools are available directly to customers in UK, Ireland, Germany, Australia, and Canada.
